content:
emma.support: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting 502s + timeouts for hosted inference in eu-west-2a. Spike started ~09:12 UTC, still ongoing. Dashboard: https://rmwrd.co/d/ops/eu-west-2a (graphs attached).

emma.support: Example customer report: "calls failing with 502 gateway error, retrying gives 504" — also seeing auth failures ~1.2% of requests. Escalating. @mike.sre can you triage?

mike.sre: On it. Can you paste short time series counts (5m) for 502/504/latency and auth failures? Any recent deploys?

olivia-prod: No infra deploys in last 2 hours. Query results (5m window): 502 rate +420% vs baseline, 504 +80%, median p50 latency +160ms, auth_error_rate from token service +1.2% (was 0.03%). CPU/mem on gateways and model hosts normal.

raj.network: Running quick mtr from eu-west-2a edge to customer-facing transit:

```
Host: edge-eu2a
Start: 2026-03-17 09:18:12 UTC
 1.|-- 10.8.1.1 0.3%  0.4ms
 2.|-- 100.64.12.1 0.0% 2.1ms
 3.|-- 198.51.100.5 12.3% 12.6ms  <-- first loss
 4.|-- 203.0.113.7 20.8% 18.9ms  <-- sustained loss
 5.|-- 198.51.200.2 46.7% 120.3ms <-- provider AS64500
 6.|-- 198.51.200.9 0.0% 125.0ms
```

raj.network: Looks like packet loss starting at provider hop (AS64500) with loss and high latency. Could be a peering or ECMP split problem causing retransmits and connection stalls -> gateway 502s.

peering-bot: Detected BGP AS-PATH change at 09:11:56 UTC for prefix 198.51.200.0/24 on transit-asn AS64500. Update ID PR-4572.

mike.sre: OK — this aligns. The auth failures are likely side-effect (clients timed out and re-auth retried or token service upstream calls degraded). Mitigation options: 1) traffic-shift eu-west-2a -> eu-west-1 for hosted inference routes, 2) request upstream provider rollback or circuit rehome, 3) enable temporary caching for auth tokens at gateway to reduce token churn.

olivia-prod: Can do traffic-shift as immediate mitigation. I'll kick canary routing to eu-west-1 for non-SLA tiers. Command to bump route weight: `infractl route adjust --from eu-west-2a --to eu-west-1 --weight 60 --scope hosted-api`

deploy-bot: Executing job infra/route-adjust/8293...
deploy-bot: Job complete. New weights: eu-west-2a=40%, eu-west-1=60%.

mike.sre: Monitor error rates and latency. If 502s drop, we keep shift and engage provider support for permanent fix.

emma.support: Notifying affected customers with temporary mitigation note and ETA to follow. Example message sent: "We've detected transient network issues impacting requests to eu-west-2a and are routing traffic to eu-west-1 as a mitigation. Expect reduced errors within ~5–10m. We're working with our transit provider for root cause." :white_check_mark:

raj.network: Opened ticket with provider (PR-4572) and included mtr + BGP snapshots. Provider acknowledged at 09:28 UTC and said they're investigating an asymmetric flap on one of their transits.

mike.sre: Current telemetry (09:28 UTC): 502 rate down -68% vs peak, auth_error_rate down to 0.2%, p50 latency still +80ms but trending down. Keep monitoring for at least 30m before reverting routes.

olivia-prod: Logged repro steps for support docs: 1) Send concurrent inference calls to eu-west-2a. 2) Observe intermittent 502/504 and TCP retransmits. 3) Run `mtr -r -c 50 <edge-ip>` and check loss at hop with provider ASN. 4) If provider loss observed, shift routing and escalate with PR-#.

emma.support: Customer-facing updates posted to status page. Will follow up once provider confirms fix.

raj.network: Provider reports they completed partial route repair at 09:40 UTC; loss reduced but still visible on one path. They expect full propagation by 09:55 UTC. PR-4572 ticket will be updated.

mike.sre: Good. After provider confirms, we'll gradually move weight back and watch for regression. Thanks all for quick turnaround.

olivia-prod: Postmortem notes: probable cause = transit provider ECMP/as-path instability causing packet loss and connection stalls at provider hop -> gateway 502s and auth churn. Mitigations used: traffic-shift, temporary token caching, provider rollback ticket. Action items: add automated route-shift runbook, pre-approved provider escalation path, and enhance auth token caching heuristics.

emma.support: Closing customer escalations for now; will reopen if we see new spikes. :lock_with_ink_pen:
